Alyssa — thanks, great to talk. Attaching a concise pilot plan and the security questionnaire (stubs below). High-level answers inline: 

- 30-day pilot objective: validate Redwood inference on 2 production-like FinLogic pipelines for latency, accuracy vs. current baseline, and cost per 1M tokens.
- Success criteria (short):
  * Latency: 95th percentile <= 350ms on 256-token requests under expected load profile
  * Quality: top-1 answer precision >= 92% on your eval set (we'll ingest your reference prompts)
  * Cost: token cost <= 0.6x of baseline (using recommended quantization + batching)
- Deliverables: onboarding runbook, model config, evaluation report, replayable inference logs (masked), and a short exec readout.
- Owners:
  * Redwood: Chloe (Pilot lead), Rishi (SRE/ops), Eng on-call for hotfixes
  * FinLogic: Alyssa (Data platforms), Tom (Integration owner), Security team for compliance gating

Attachments (referenced): [attachment: pilot_success_criteria.xlsx (xlsx)], [attachment: finlogic_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Proposed working session: Wed, Sep 16 at 11:00am PT — would that work for you and Tom?

I'll also open an internal issue tracker for blockers and post weekly status notes.

Best,
Chloe

Great — confirmed for Wed 11 PT. Quick pre-read and commitments: 

- Security artifacts: attaching SOC2 summary (redacted) and pen-test summary stub. We do not retain raw customer data in hosted evaluation; temporary logs are kept for 72 hours by default and then automatically purged. We can shorten retention to 24 hours for the pilot and will enable PII redaction plugin at ingestion.
- Pilot milestones and owners (short):
  Week 0 (onboarding): FinLogic provides sample prompts + eval set; Redwood sets up dedicated trial variant
  Week 1: Ingest & baseline run; initial latency/accuracy numbers; first bug triage if needed
  Week 2: Optimization (quantization/batching), retest
  Week 3: Final evaluation, exec readout prep
  Week 4: Wrap & handoff; delivery of final report

- Escalation path: first-level: Rishi (SRE) for infra/perf; second-level: Lauren (Sales Manager) for contract/sla exceptions; executive escalation to VP if unresolved in 48 hours.

References: [attachment: redwood-mutual-action-plan-v1.docx (docx)]

See you Wed.

-Chloe
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Harris <tharris@finlogic.com>, Alyssa King <alyssa.king@finlogic.com>, FinLogic IT Security <security@finlogic.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:32:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot — blocker discovered during baseline run; mitigation plan

Team — post-workshop update: during baseline ingestion (Tuesday night) our infra ran into a model-bind exception on one of FinLogic's longer prompt templates (approx 1,800 tokens after concatenation). The behavior: 95th latency spikes and occasional incomplete responses with an internal kernel OOM.

Mitigation steps taken so far: 
- Rolled the request to a larger instance type and enabled sequence-splitting to prevent single-request OOMs (temporary patch).
- Captured replay logs and a sanitized sample prompt (attached) and opened internal bug RED-3943 for the kernel OOM path.
- Notified engineering on-call; they will provide a hardened fix by Tue EOD (target).

Impact to pilot timeline: if fix hits Tue EOD and we validate replays Wed, we expect a 3-day slip in the week-1 optimization cadence. Contingency: we can scope the pilot to the shorter prompt subset in parallel to keep progress on accuracy/latency for the main workload.

Action items / owners: 
- Rishi: own mitigation & infra patch, ETA Tue EOD
- Chloe: update FinLogic on scope shift and reconfirm acceptance criteria window
- Lauren: approve minor schedule shift and any temporary compute overage credits (if needed)

Attachments: [attachment: sanitized_prompt_sample.txt (txt)], [attachment: replay_log_09016.json (log stub)]

Tom/Alyssa — apologies for the hiccup; we'll follow up with a short remediation note and updated timeline this afternoon.

-Rishi
SRE, Redwood Inference
